project_info.address: Plot No 33, Phase-1 Sancharpuri Colony, New Bowenpally, Hyderabad 500011
project_info.tagline: Global Commodities. Trusted Networks. Timely Delivery.
project_info.business_focus: International commodity trading across petrochemicals, food commodities, metals, and ores. B2B and B2G.

design_system.vibe: Premium, global, modern, high-trust, Trafigura-style enterprise.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-900
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-900

surface_strategies.header: Crystal Glass: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-200 shadow-sm
surface_strategies.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-slate-200), rounded-none or very subtle rounded-sm. Hover: -translate-y-1 shadow-xl shadow-blue-900/5
surface_strategies.footer: Deep Navy background (bg-[#0A192F]) with white/slate-300 text. py-24.

buttons.primary: bg-[#0A192F] text-white hover:bg-blue-600 transition-colors px-6 py-3 rounded-none font-medium
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#0A192F] text-[#0A192F] hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors px-6 py-3 rounded-none font-medium
buttons.inquiry_cta: bg-blue-600 text-white hover:bg-blue-700 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-none font-medium text-sm flex items-center gap-2

components.whatsapp_float: fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-50 bg-[#25D366] text-white p-4 rounded-full shadow-lg hover:scale-105 transition-transform flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer
components.forms: Use Shadcn Form components. Inputs must have border-slate-300, rounded-none, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-600.

hero_bg.description: Cargo operations during sunrise at a busy port
hero_bg.usage: Hero section background with deep navy overlay (bg-slate-900/60)

ores.description: Pile of colorful ores and rocks

services_logistics.usage: Services section visual or About Us background

global_elements.navigation: Sticky glassmorphism header. Logo left, Links center, CTA 'Send Inquiry' right. Must be visible on desktop.
global_elements.floating_action: WhatsApp button fixed bottom-right on all pages. data-testid='whatsapp-float-button'
global_elements.footer: Dark navy background. Contains Contact Info, Quick Links, and Legal.

hero.layout: Full screen (min-h-[80vh]). Deep navy/black overlay on image to ensure text contrast.
hero.content: H1: Premium enterprise messaging. Tagline. Dual CTAs: 'Explore Commodities' (Primary), 'Send Trade Inquiry' (Secondary/Outline).

about_preview.layout: Split layout (text left, image or stats right).
about_preview.content: Mission, Vision. High trust corporate messaging. Focus on 2025 founding and global reach.

commodities.content: Cards for Petrochemicals, Food, Metals, Ores. CRITICAL: Every item must have a 'Send Inquiry' CTA button.
commodities.style: Image background cards with dark gradient at bottom for text legibility. Crisp, non-rounded edges.

services.layout: 3-column grid of 6 text-heavy, clean corporate cards.
services.content: Supply Chain, Risk Hedging, Freight & Logistics, Trade Finance, Storage, Quality Assurance.

markets.layout: Clean typographic section. NO INTERACTIVE MAP. CRITICAL.
markets.content: List of key markets: UAE, Brazil, Ecuador, USA, Asia, MENA, LATAM. Use large typography and statistical presentation instead of a map.

insights.style: Border-b 'editorial ribbon' style, no heavy card enclosures. Date, Category, Title.

contact.layout: Two-column layout. Contact Info (left) + Lead Gen Form (right).
contact.style: Enterprise-grade form, clean inputs, full-width submit button.
